data.title: Composite Document Dispatch Delayed for Potential Evergrande Property Services Offer
data.description:
An update from Evergrande Property Services Group Ltd. ( (HK:6666) ) is now available.

data.title: Jinhui Subsidiary Redeemed Three Alibaba-Linked Fixed-Coupon Notes
data.description:
An announcement from Jinhui Holdings Co. Ltd. ( (HK:0137) ) is now available.

Jinhui Holdings is an investment holding company whose subsidiaries are principally engaged in international ship chartering and ship owning. Its approximately 55.69% indirect subsidiary is principally engaged in investment trading and redeemed equity-linked fixed-coupon notes linked to Alibaba shares.

On 18 November 2026, the subsidiary redeemed two notes issued by SG Issuer and BNP Paribas, with principal amounts of CNY14 million and CNY6 million, at redemption prices of HK$117.2427 and HK$118.0645 per share, respectively; it had also redeemed a CNY14 million UBS AG note on 16 September 2026 at HK$114.2342 per share. Across the three redemptions, the aggregated principal was approximately HK$35,176,000, making the transactions disclosable under Hong Kong listing rules because an applicable percentage exceeded 5% but was below 25%.

data.title: SouthGobi Receives Request for Proposed PIK Interest Share Issue
data.description:
An update from SouthGobi Resources ( (TSE:SGQ) ) is now available.

SouthGobi Resources said it received a notice from JD Zhixing Fund L.P. to exercise its right to require payment of US$6.1 million in accrued and outstanding payment-in-kind interest under the company’s US$250 million convertible debenture issued on November 19, 2009, and related deferral agreements.

Under the request, SouthGobi would issue JDZF 26,143,202 common shares, representing approximately 6.59% of issued and outstanding common shares, in satisfaction of the interest payment. data.title: Nan Nan Resources Signals Preliminary Interim Profit Turnaround
data.description:
An update from Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited ( (HK:1229) ) is now available.

Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited said a preliminary review of unaudited management accounts indicates the Group is expected to move from an approximately HK$3.44 million loss for the six months ended 30 September 2025 to not less than approximately HK$45 million profit for the six months ended 30 September 2026. Final figures remain subject to accounting adjustments, and the interim results have not been audited or reviewed.

The expected change was mainly attributable to an approximately HK$52.76 million fair-value gain on the Company’s HK$200 million zero-coupon convertible bond, a HK$6.39 million decrease in selling and distribution expenses, and a HK$15.56 million increase in administrative and other operating expenses. Excluding the bond fair-value change, the Group expects to record a loss of not more than approximately HK$7.76 million, with the bond valuation movement mainly linked to changes in the Company’s stock price.

data.title: MTT Group Expects Six-Month Loss of About HK$23.7 Million
data.description:
MTT Group Holdings Limited ( (HK:2350) ) has shared an update.

MTT Group Holdings operates distribution and system integration solutions businesses; the release does not specify its primary products or market focus. Based on a preliminary assessment, the Group expects a loss of approximately HK$23.7 million for the six months ended 30 September 2026, compared with approximately HK$14.5 million a year earlier.

Gross profit is expected to have fallen to approximately HK$18.0 million from HK$24.1 million as intense market competition affected both segments, while about HK$9.2 million in research and development expenses were incurred, versus nil in the corresponding period. A net reversal of expected credit loss impairments of about HK$1.1 million, compared with net impairment losses of HK$2.7 million previously, partly offset these factors; the figures remain unaudited and may change before interim results are finalised.

data.title: Yunfeng Reallocates HK$350 Million of Proceeds to Repay Shareholder Loan
data.description:
Yunfeng Financial Group Limited ( (HK:0376) ) has provided an announcement.

Yunfeng Financial Group said development and capital deployment for its virtual asset-related business had been slower than originally anticipated, citing changing market conditions, an evolving regulatory framework and time needed to assess commercial viability and implementation requirements. The board therefore approved reallocating HK$350.0 million of the HK$1,152.8 million net proceeds from a September 2025 top-up placing, originally earmarked for that business, to repay shareholder-loan principal.

The repayment will reduce the loan’s outstanding principal from HK$1,641.08 million to HK$1,291.08 million. The company said reducing interest-bearing debt offers a more immediate and quantifiable financial benefit than retaining substantial funds for investments that may not materialise, amid prevailing borrowing costs and uncertainty over future interest rates.

data.title: Zhengwei Group Proposes Capital Reduction and Share Subdivision
data.description:
An announcement from Zhengwei Group Holdings Company Limited ( (HK:2147) ) is now available.

Zhengwei Group Holdings Company Limited is incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under stock code 2147. The company has called an extraordinary general meeting for 10 December 2026 to consider a special resolution on its share capital.

Subject to listing, regulatory and Cayman Islands requirements, the proposal would reduce each issued share’s par value from USD0.2 to HK$0.01 and subdivide each authorised but unissued share into 156 new HK$0.01 shares. The resulting credit would be used to offset accumulated losses, with any remaining balance transferred to a distributable reserve, while the authorised share capital would be revised to HK$1.248 billion divided into 124.8 billion new shares.

data.title: Elegance Optical Provides Resumption Update as Trading Suspension Continues
data.description:
The latest update is out from Elegance Optical International Holdings Limited ( (HK:0907) ).

Elegance Optical International Holdings Limited’s Group operates an eyewear trading business. During 1 April–30 September 2026, it secured and completed 10 contracts or orders valued at approximately HK$31.6 million, with Customer A accounting for approximately 30% of segment revenue.

Trading in the Company’s shares has been suspended since 23 April 2026 and remains suspended until further notice. The Board updated shareholders and investors on the Group’s operations, financial position and progress toward fulfilling resumption guidance, while the disclosed figures remain preliminary, unaudited and subject to change pending completion of the auditor’s review.

Unaudited segment profit was approximately HK$2.8 million, compared with approximately HK$6.4 million in the previous review period, while the number of contracts or orders remained 10. Contract or order value was approximately HK$31.6 million, compared with approximately HK$21.9 million in the previous review period.

data.title: Newtrend Group Announces Up to HK$20 Million H-Share Repurchase Plan
data.description:
The latest update is out from Newtrend Group Holding Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:2573) ).

Newtrend Group Holding’s board resolved to repurchase the company’s H shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for an aggregate amount of up to HK$20 million, under a general mandate approved by shareholders on June 5, 2026. The repurchases may be conducted from time to time until the mandate expires or is ended earlier.

The proposed repurchase is to be financed with the company’s own financial resources, excluding proceeds from its global offering, and must comply with applicable rules. The company said it had not repurchased any H shares under the mandate as of the announcement, while transactions will not proceed if they would breach public-float requirements or trigger a mandatory general offer.

data.title: Domaine Power Reports Higher Revenue and Wider Interim Loss
data.description:
An update from Domaine Power Holdings Limited ( (HK:0442) ) is now available.

Domaine Power Holdings reported revenue of approximately HK$109.6 million for the six months ended 30 September 2026, up 31.6% from the comparable 2025 period. It recorded a gross loss of approximately HK$2.1 million, compared with gross profit of HK$851,000 a year earlier, while the gross margin changed to a 1.9% loss margin from a 1.0% profit margin.

The Group’s consolidated loss attributable to equity holders increased 52.3% to approximately HK$11.5 million, while basic and diluted losses per share remained approximately HK$0.04. The interim results were unaudited but reviewed by the audit committee, and the Board did not recommend an interim dividend.
